content:
Eva: Heads up — Canary traffic for region-eu is showing a spike in tail latency and a handful of 5xxs after the runtime=3.2 rollout with llama3q-v4b. Not huge but consistent across different clients.

Dan: saw that too. error logs point to OOM-ish traces in the runtime when sequence > 8k. could be the new kvcache indexing tweak.

DeployBot: [scheduled action] Runtime rollout 3.2 applied to canary pool at 2024-10-12T09:44:22Z. Monitoring probes enabled.

Shilpa: can we toggle the SDK shim (compat layer) back to v2 behavior to see if it reduces memory pressure? quick toggle, no code change for customers.

Dan: +1. If shim affects chunking/KV write order that'd explain the spike. Shilpa — what's the command?

Shilpa: run this on devops:```sh
/ops toggleset sdk_shim_mode canary v1-compat --reason "runtime 3.2 canary latency/5xx triage" --expires "2h"
```

Tomas: if we flip shim and it doesn't help, fallback plan is to pin the runtime back to 3.1 in canary and then do a controlled unroll to prod. We'll need a quick rollback window.

Eva: agree. Also consider model-side fallback: route llama3q-v4b -> llama3q-v4a (smaller KV footprint) for canary only. That keeps runtime while reducing memory.

Dan: tradeoffs: model downgrade impacts perf/quality. For canary it's fine. I lean to toggling shim first, then model fallback, then runtime pin as last resort.

QA Bot: quick smoke tests queued: run-suite "longseq-regression" on canary after each change.

Shilpa: toggled sdk_shim_mode -> v1-compat on canary at 2024-10-12T09:58:40Z. Monitoring.

DeployBot: action complete: toggleset applied to pool=canary-eu by Shilpa.

Eva: initial telemetry looks better — tail P95 down ~18%, only 1 intermittent 5xx in last 10m.

Tomas: good. Let's keep shim on for 1 hour and watch. If stable, we'll open PR to keep shim for canary-only until we ship a kernel fix. If it regresses, execute model fallback.

Dan: logging the rollback runbook here for posterity:
```
1) If regression after shim toggle -> run: /deploy route model llama3q-v4b -> llama3q-v4a --scope canary-eu --dry-run false
2) If still bad -> /deploy pin runtime 3.1 --scope canary-eu --expires 4h --notify #eng-oncall
3) Post-mortem + telemetry correlation, then plan permanent fix
```

Eva: adding owners: @Shilpa (ops), @Dan (runtime), @Tomas (releases). Will update release notes draft if we end up pinning.

Shilpa: setting alert to pager if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 10m.

DeployBot: alert rule updated by Shilpa.

QA Bot: smoke tests passed after shim toggle: longseq-regression: OK. No functional regressions observed.

Tomas: based on current data, we will hold unpin for now. Plan: monitor 60m, then decide. If stable, mark as "observed mitigated" and include mitigation in release notes: "Canary shim compatibility toggle applied; kernel fix scheduled".

Dan: filing a follow-up issue for kernel indexing edge-case and adding a perf test in CI.

Eva: thanks all. keeping thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
